findings.text: The company was incorporated on 6 December 2013 and currently has the status 'active'.
No insolvency record is held for the company.

Accounts are not overdue, with the next due date being 30 September 2027 and the last made up to 31 December 2025.

Eleven charges are registered in total, all of which are satisfied, with no outstanding or part-satisfied charges.
One director, PERSON 643, has 49 other appointments, including two in liquidation, while the other four checked directors have fewer or no other appointments.
Since 24 October 2025, there have been no registered office address changes and one officer appointment, PERSON 644, on 9 July 2026.
